summary: Murano Global Investments Plc furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) on October 7, 2026, disclosing a board-initiated strategic review to evaluate options aimed at enhancing shareholder value over time, with no assurance of any particular outcome. No advisor, price, stake, or premium was disclosed. Separately, the board updated progress on restructuring roughly $300 million of 11.000% senior secured notes due 2031, completed August 14, 2026, plus Sofoplus, Exitus, NAFIN, Bancomext and Finamo settlements, including payment-in-kind property transfers and a missed July 7 Bancomext amortization. Watch for asset-sale or take-private outcomes, lender negotiation risk, and disclosure timing.
